program.section_heading: Vocational Nursing - Associate of Science Degree and Certificate of Achievement - AS588/AS588C/CE588
outcomes: Provide quality, safe, patient-centered basic nursing care using evidence-based practices, as a competent, entry-level vocational nurse, under the direct supervision of a licensed physician or registered nurse.

Function as a competent entry-level, vocational nurse accepting accountability and responsibility for the ethical and legal principles defined in the vocational nursing code of ethics and practice act.
Function as a leader, assimilating leadership principles in a variety of health care settings for diverse patient populations as a competent, entry-level vocational nurse.
Exemplify caring through behaviors that support relationship-centered care and demonstrate respect and sensitivity to others as a competent, entry-level vocational nurse.

Assimilate collaborative relationships through communication with the interprofessional health care team for the purpose of providing and improving patient outcomes as a competent, entry-level vocational nurse.

Assimilate critical thinking principles using clinical reasoning to make sound clinical judgments necessary for providing safe patient care and contributing to quality improvement as a competent, entry-level vocational nurse.

Integrate nursing informatics and technology to effectively communicate, enhance knowledge, manage and analyze data, prevent errors, and support decision-making as a competent, entry-level vocational nurse.

notes: The page prints a single requirements list and one Program Learning Outcomes list shared by the A.S. degree and the Certificate of Achievement (AS588/AS588C/CE588); the A.S. degree record uses that shared list and outcomes.
Two headings are printed with different codes (AS588/AS588C/CE588 and AS588/AS588B/AS588C/CE588); the first was used as section_heading.
The choice 'Take one of the following groups' prints a combined total of 3.00-8.00 units; Group 1 (3.00) and Group 2 (8.00) are recorded as option blocks.
The 'Required Courses' heading's 'Units: 49.50- 54.50' is the program total, not a block total, so the required-course block has no stated total.
NVN-55A, NVN-55B, NVN-42, NVN-42A, NVN-44, NVN-44A and NVN-45 are marked '( Historical )' in the catalog; reviewer may wish to verify currency for 2026-2027.
The degree requires general education but the text names no specific GE pattern, so ge_pattern is null.
